newsitem.title: THAILAND: GOLF-WOODS SIX AHEAD IN BANGKOK CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WOODS SIX AHEAD IN BANGKOK CLASSIC.

text.p: Tiger Woods stretched his lead to six strokes with another breathtaking performance in the Bangkok Classic third round on Saturday.
The American shot a six-under-par 66 for a 16-under total of 200.
Thailand-based American Greg Hanrahan, a touring professional for only two years, filled second place after a 70.
Woods made seven birdies. His only setback was at the par four 18th where he dropped a shot after driving into the rough and failed to reach the green with his second.
"I still have to go out tomorrow and take care of business," said Woods. "I still have to execute every shot. I will have to play smart -- whether that is aggressive or conservative I do not know."
